text:
monique: Quick Q: For the long-term routing roadmap doc, should we include specific numeric thresholds for SLOs or leave them as ranges? Example: p95 <= 200ms vs p95 target 150-250ms.

shawn: I vote numeric targets. Engineers need concrete thresholds to test against. Ranges lead to bikeshedding.

zara: Agree with numeric but allow per-tier adjustments (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Put them in an appendix for easy tuning.

ops-bot: scheduled-check: attach-slo-policy template created (id=88921)

finance: Also call out cost thresholds explicitly. Blanket statements make forecasting hard.

monique: ok we'll lock numbers and put a recommended range in the appendix. Thanks.
